observations: D-R28-01 seeds (in-memory exec of r10_parts.py, budget regenerated into the probe dir): loaded_pack back to 5.456 V x (1.46 A + aux_A) moves only pack_7V4/6V0_four_stall_loaded_V (5.880831 -> 5.881014, 4.388491 -> 4.388745 V); ports_w with the 1.46 A literal moves 53 budget values (fire 4-stall 5.713190 -> 5.713377 V). No check reads these budget values, so a regenerated budget passes; this is the class rounds 26/28 ruled not a gate miss (no stated rule binds a budget figure to a check). A hand-edited stale budget is caught: r10_parts --check --budget-only prints 'stale: parts_budget.json', rc 1.

Binding-note seed S19 (obligation 15's '166–196 V/s' changed to '16.6–19.6 V/s'): the pinned test passes; K-binding fails until the note is regenerated. The pins cover every D-R28/D-R29 label and qualifier, not every figure; no stated rule requires every figure to be pinned.

Right-angle seed at C80.2 (GND, F.Cu, chamfer (15.475,79.5)-(15.875,79.9) reverted to a corner at (15.475,79.9)): route_check does not flag it, correctly: the node and its inner corner (15.675,80.1) lie inside C80.2's 1.15 x 1.8 mm pad copper, which the rule exempts.

C10's 3 mm U5 coat-exclusion distance (ORDERING 8.3, 3.016596 mm) has no automated gate; it is a hand-measured procedure figure, not an AGENTS/REQUIREMENTS design rule. C10 alone moved 0.6 mm south keeps PYRO1_OUT/rails 1.040 mm and gates/rails 1.0585 mm, so test_r26_pyro1_out passing on that seed is correct.
